description: Reads, creates, changes and removes routines: saved instructions the assistant runs on a schedule or when a CRM event fires. action list returns compact summaries (id, name, owner, trigger, enabled) by default; includePrompts: true returns full configurations including prompts. owner: 'mine' limits results to routines the caller owns; page, pageSize and searchTerm paginate and search. action runs returns one routine's run history newest first, paginated by cursor, each with its status, summary, triggerKind and error block reason. action create needs name, prompt and triggerKind, plus cronExpression for a schedule, or triggerEvents for an event. Record events (record.created, record.updated, record.deleted) also need recordTrigger for one list or recordSources for several lists; the query filters decide which records fire the routine, and record events can be combined with messaging events in one routine. Omitting enabled on create produces a routine that is immediately LIVE and will start running; enabled false creates a draft. action update changes only the fields supplied, but a change of triggerKind must arrive with that kind's schedule or events or validation fails. action pause disables a routine and settles its queued runs to skipped; re-enabling restores the schedule but not those runs. Only an active system administrator may pause. action run_now starts a scheduled routine immediately. Manual test runs still have triggerKind schedule. It refuses an event routine, another owner's routine, a disabled routine, paused AI work, an inactive owner or exhausted credits before queuing and reports the reason. action delete moves the routine to Trash, where it stops running; the returned trashBatchId identifies the Trash batch it can be restored from, and only deleting it permanently removes its history. A routine whose owner has been deactivated cannot be enabled, and creating one may be refused when the owner has used their plan's per-user routine allowance.

action.description: list = compact routine summaries by default (optional page, pageSize, searchTerm, owner, includePrompts); runs = one routine's run history (id, optional cursor); create = name, prompt, triggerKind, enabled, plus cronExpression and timezone for a schedule or triggerEvents for an event (record events also need recordTrigger or recordSources; optional debounceSeconds); update = id plus the fields to change; pause, run_now and delete = id.

cronExpression.description: Five-field cron. Runs may be no closer together than 15 minutes.

cursor.description: runs only. Page cursor returned by a previous runs request.

enabled.description: Omitting this on create produces a LIVE routine; false creates a draft.

expectedSchemaRevision.description: Required when supplying recordTrigger: the current schema revision of the record model, as returned by type discovery.

id.description: Routine id. Required for update, pause, run_now and delete.

includePrompts.description: list only. Include the full routine configurations and prompts; false returns compact summaries.

owner.description: list only. mine returns routines owned by the caller.

pageSize.description: list only. Results per page, any whole number from 1 to 100, served exactly: page 2 of pageSize 50 holds records 51 to 100. When a result was truncated, ask again with about half the size. Default 25.

prompt.description: The instructions the assistant receives on every run. Required on create.

operator.description: For multiple choice fields in, all and notIn take option values and match records holding any, all or none of them. between uses two inclusive date endpoints in values; overlaps takes the same endpoints and also matches a date range that only partly falls between them; a range without an end counts as its start day. inLastDays and notInLastDays use a positive whole day count in value as a decimal without currency. Range contains tests a point; gt/gte test its start, lt/lte its end. Relative windows begin at UTC midnight that many days before the query clock: inLastDays includes later dates, notInLastDays matches only earlier ones.

anyOf.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

recordIds.description: Match these terminal record identities after following the path; all steps require record access.

recordTrigger.description: For record.created/updated/deleted from one list: a query with stable typeId, filters and relationships, plus watched field IDs (changedFieldIds). The query filters decide which records fire the routine. Deletion filters match before removal; creation and update filters match the resulting state and are rechecked at admission. Current owner access is rechecked. recordSources watches several lists.

searchTerm.description: list only. Free-text match against the routine name.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron is read in.

triggerEvents.description: Events an event routine reacts to. Required for triggerKind event.

name: manage_routines

outputSchema.description: list returns items, total, page and pageSize; each item is a compact id, name, owner, trigger and enabled summary unless includePrompts is true. owner: mine limits the list to the caller. runs returns items with status, triggerKind and error block reason, plus nextCursor; create, update and pause return the routine's id, name and enabled (false after pause); run_now returns started on success or a specific failure before queuing; delete returns deleted and id.
